methodology:
Genting Plantations is a hybrid palm + property developer with 243,200 ha total landbank including plasma schemes. Plantation footprint: ~64K ha Malaysia (Sabah + Peninsular) + ~143K ha Indonesia nucleus (West/Central/South Kalimantan) + ~36K ha Indonesia plasma. 13 oil mills total: 1 W. Malaysia + 6 Sabah + 6 Indonesia.

CRITICAL CHANGE vs prior version: Indonesia plasma estates (~36K ha = 88K acres) now correctly carved out via excludeFromAcreTotals=true. Plasma is owned by smallholder farmers under Indonesia's mandatory plasma program — GENP buys FFB but doesn't own the land. Consistent with how plasma is treated for AALI/SIMP/P8Z/SGRO/SSMS/RE.L.

6-row breakdown:
- Sabah Malaysia (110K acres + 6 mills): largest Malaysian cluster, freehold
- Peninsular Malaysia (25K acres + 1 mill): smaller W. Malaysia, freehold
- Indonesia Kalimantan nucleus (354K acres + 7 mills): GENP-owned Indonesia operations
- Indonesia plasma (88K acres = 36K ha, EXCLUDED from owned acres): smallholder partnerships
- Property development (15K acres): Iskandar Malaysia + 152 ha Sentul Indonesia (RM593M July 2024 acquisition for property development = premium urban-fringe pricing)
- Genomics R&D placeholder (not land asset)

Property development segment is meaningful — GENP combines plantation + Iskandar Malaysia urban land + Indonesian urban property. Per-acre marks vary 100-200x across segments.
